# Coworking Space in ADGM — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM operates a coworking space and business centre inside Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), at Addax Tower, 3812, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Hot desk from AED 1,000/month, dedicated desk from AED 1,150/month, private office from AED 4,500/month, day pass AED 100.

This site (coworkingspaceinadgm.com) is a one-page guide to coworking in ADGM published by Aegis Coworking, an office space provider in ADGM offering flexible office space in ADGM, flexi desks and cheap desk space in ADGM to rent by the day or month. The main website is https://www.aegiscoworking.ae.

## Key facts

- Location: Addax Tower, 38th floor (Unit 3812), Al Reem Island — within the ADGM jurisdiction
- Workspace types: Coworking Day Pass, Hot Desk (Flexi Desk), Dedicated Desk, Private Office, Virtual Office, Meeting Room
- Dedicated desks, private offices and virtual offices include a registered business address suitable for ADGM company registration and licence renewal
- 24/7 access for dedicated desk and private office members
- No deposit, no setup or admin fees, free registration; one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee for the dedicated desk; ADGM government fees separate
- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

## Pricing

- Coworking Day Pass: AED 100 (9 AM–6 PM) or AED 150 (24 hours)
- Hot Desk / Flexi Desk: from AED 1,000 per month
- Dedicated Desk: AED 1,150/month
- Private Office: from AED 4,500 per month (teams of 1–20+)
- Virtual Office: from AED 292 per month
- Meeting Room: hourly booking

## Which workspace an ADGM licence usually needs

- SPV or holding company: flexi desk
- Tech Start-Up and most operating licences: dedicated desk
- FSRA-regulated activity: private office
- No licence, just a place to work: day pass or hot desk
